examples.name: Default
examples.summary: The Retail page's band: the storefront pitch beside a scrolling wall of eight deploy templates, closed by a marquee of compatible frameworks and clouds. Marks flagged `invertInDark` invert under the dark theme. Edit the props in the Controls panel — a band with no templates renders nothing at all. Every card with an `href` links as a whole: a click anywhere on it follows the template, while its deploy button stays the one tab stop. The band carries an `anchor`.

examples.name: Closing
examples.summary: The templates band as a page's close: with `closing` set the hatched closing frame follows it. Here `hatch` is off because a `panel` closing call to action stacks right under it and draws the page's one closing frame.
